audio_description:
A capsule slides down the Lunar Gate's launch tube.
The screen whites out in the blaze of launch.
The view settles on the facility beneath an enormous moon.

context.scene_title: The Lunar Gate launch — the capsule rides the tube and is fired toward the moon (Disc 3).
locations: The colorful interior launch tube of the Lunar Gate; a blinding launch flash; and the exterior facility under a huge moon at dusk

characters.name: (launch capsule, occupant sealed)
characters.recognition: A small pod travels down the bright tube; occupant (Squall/Rinoa/party member) sealed inside, not visible.

context.summary: A capsule slides down the Lunar Gate's vivid launch tube, the screen whites out in the blaze of the launch, and the view settles on the facility beneath an enormous moon — the destination toward which the capsule is fired.
context.context_note: Read as the Lunar Gate launch and the moon (Disc 3); occupant not visible.
